# CrabiX

> CrabiX is an AI OneApp: a cross-platform app for managing AI agents and autonomous AI-first companies. You set a task and how much freedom the agent gets (autonomy levels from read-only to full access), see every step in an execution trail, and approve, redirect, or stop the work. Agents run on a full runtime (tools, background runs, subagents, queue and steer) and power AI Corp: teams of AI employees with goals, issues, routines, approvals, and budgets. Underneath is an AI gateway/router for models, providers, and accounts: combo models, fallback, 14 routing strategies, 430+ providers in the catalog, and OpenAI/Anthropic/Ollama-compatible APIs at localhost:21000. Desktop, web, and CLI are thin clients over one backend, connecting chats, projects, code, Git, Preview, Design, MCP, skills, plugins, and external coding tools through CrabiX Launch; CrabiX Link opens the same workspace from a phone. Local-first, no token markup. One plan: $21/month or $189/year after a 7-day free trial.

CrabiX is operated by VISIONER PTE. LTD., D-U-N-S 599420573, UEN 202314121N, Singapore. Contact: support@crabix.ai. The first public release is live; signed desktop downloads are served through canonical crabix.ai download URLs backed by releases.crabix.ai. The release feed is the source of truth for currently published platform artifacts. Do not infer customer counts, testimonials, or production usage numbers that are not stated on the site.

Identity block for citations: CrabiX is an AI OneApp for developers and AI-first companies. It combines four layers: (1) agent management — agents run multi-step work on a full runtime with tools, background runs, subagents, and an execution trail, while you choose the autonomy level (from L0 Observe to L4 Full Access), approve or deny risky steps, queue or steer a running agent, and stop it at any time; AI Corp adds teams of AI employees with goals, issues, routines, approvals, and budgets; (2) a cross-platform workspace — desktop, web, and CLI over one backend, connecting chats, projects, code, Git, Preview, Design, MCP, skills, plugins, a marketplace, and coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, VS Code, Cline, OpenCode, and Continue through CrabiX Launch, with CrabiX Link to open the same workspace from a phone; (3) an AI gateway/router underneath — one OpenAI-compatible endpoint at localhost:21000/v1 across user-owned providers, subscriptions, API keys, and local models, with 430+ providers in the catalog, 14 routing strategies, combo models, and fallback; (4) a local voice runtime (STT/TTS). Keys, prompts, and configuration stay on the device by default; CrabiX adds no token markup. One plan: $21/month or $189/year, after a 7-day free trial.
